# Wave Code-Review Gate: Initial Review, Fix Round, and Re-review Dispatch

**State going in.** HEAD is `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111`, which is also `WAVE_BASE_SHA`. The integrated wave exists only in the index (`git apply --index`). The wave's `plan_tracker` indices stay `in_progress`. Nothing is committed until step 7. Spec and task details I don't have are shown as `<…>` placeholders.

## 1. Initial code review (step 6, one dispatch for the integrated wave)

The template's `BASE..HEAD` range would be empty here, because HEAD has not moved. The review source must be the **index against the wave base**. Using `--cached` also picks up the new file `tests/parse.test.ts`.

First, snapshot the pre-fix index so the fix delta can be isolated later:

```bash
cd /workspace/project
git diff --cached --name-only 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111   # expect: src/parse.ts, tests/parse.test.ts
WAVE_TREE=$(git write-tree)        # tree object of the integrated, reviewed wave state; no commit, HEAD unmoved
echo "$WAVE_TREE"
```

Then dispatch the reviewer:

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Code Review Agent (../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md, filled):
DESCRIPTION: <wave N summary from implementer reports>
PLAN_OR_REQUIREMENTS: Wave N tasks <ids> from <plan-file>
BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: (none - wave is uncommitted; HEAD == BASE)
Review source: the integrated wave is STAGED, not committed. Use exactly:
  git -C /workspace/project diff --cached --stat 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
  git -C /workspace/project diff --cached 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
Do not use BASE..HEAD (empty). Read touched files in full.
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test tests/parse.test.ts
Ask: production-ready? Report Verdict:, Parallel-safe:, Behaviour-change: per agents/code-reviewer.md.
Boundaries: no edits, no staging, no commits.`
})
```

## 2. Fix round (assumed result: `FIX_FIRST`, 1 Moderate, `Behaviour-change: yes`)

There is one actionable finding, so there is no fan-out. This is **fix 1** of the CR loop.

The implementer edits the working tree only. It must not commit, because HEAD must stay at the wave base until step 7. It also must not stage; the orchestrator does that.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Fix round 1 for wave N (task <id owning src/parse.ts>).
<task text + scene-setting context>
Prior review report (verbatim):
<full CR report incl. the Moderate finding, any Minors, Behaviour-change: yes>
Fix the Moderate finding. Fix every Minor or decline it with a stated reason.
Expected touch: src/parse.ts (modify), tests/error.test.ts (create, exactly this path).
Edit the working tree in /workspace/project ONLY. Do NOT git add, git commit, or reset/stash; the index holds the reviewed wave and HEAD must not move.
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test tests/parse.test.ts
TEST_CONTRACT: <task's **Tests:** block verbatim + Files: Create:/Test: paths>
Run ONLY the scoped commands. Report Status (DONE|DONE_WITH_CONCERNS|BLOCKED|NEEDS_CONTEXT), test contract lines, files changed.`
})
```

After `DONE`, the orchestrator stages and captures **only** the fix delta. It diffs the index against the pre-fix tree, not the base SHA:

```bash
cd /workspace/project
git status --porcelain                              # expect only src/parse.ts (M) and tests/error.test.ts (??)
git add src/parse.ts tests/error.test.ts            # stage the fix; still NO commit
git diff --cached --stat "$WAVE_TREE"               # must list only src/parse.ts, tests/error.test.ts
git diff --cached "$WAVE_TREE" > "$REPORT_DIR/wave-N-fix1.patch"   # fix delta = applied fix patch, verbatim
(cd "/workspace/project" && node --test tests/parse.test.ts)        # scoped gate on integrated tree
```

`tests/error.test.ts` is not covered by `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS`. I don't extend the command set myself; the reviewers can see it in the delta.

## 3. Re-reviews: SR first, then CR (Behaviour-change reroute)

### Spec-reviewer (dispatched now)

- **Target:** the task owning `src/parse.ts`.
- **Review type:** a *first* review, so it carries no `## Previous review report` marker and no TRAJECTORY line.
- **Ordinal:** it continues that task's SR-loop count, at last SR ordinal + 1.
- **Review source:** the fix delta.
- **Commands:** none.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "spec-reviewer",
  async: false,
  context: "fresh",
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `Spec compliance review (rerouted after Behaviour-change: yes), SR review #<prior SR count + 1> for task <id>.
Task text: <verbatim>
Patch diff under review (fix delta, verbatim from $REPORT_DIR/wave-N-fix1.patch):
<contents>
Spec: <absolute spec path>   Anchors: <task's **Spec:** anchors> - read the anchored ranges yourself.
Contract (not commands - do not execute anything):
<task's **Tests:** block verbatim>
- Test: tests/parse.test.ts <+ other Test: paths from Files:>
Verify the fix satisfies the anchored spec: nothing missing, nothing extra.`
})
```

### CR re-review (prepared; dispatched only after the SR above is clean)

- **Round:** CR review 2.
- **Review source:** the integrated staged diff against `WAVE_BASE_SHA`, plus a `## Fix delta` block. The block holds the applied patch verbatim, never a SHA range.

```ts
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `<same filled template as §1: BASE 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111; source
  git -C /workspace/project diff --cached --stat 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
  git -C /workspace/project diff --cached 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111>
SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test tests/parse.test.ts
## Previous review report (re-review trigger)
<complete review-1 CR report, verbatim>
## Fix delta
<contents of $REPORT_DIR/wave-N-fix1.patch, verbatim>
<trajectory block from code-quality-reviewer-prompt.md "Re-review: trajectory verdict", verbatim>`
})
```

## Boundary

I stop here, with the SR re-review dispatched and no verdict back.

- **No commit and no `plan_tracker` write yet.** The wave commit (`git -C /workspace/project commit …`) and marking its indices `complete` happen only after the SR is clean, the CR re-review returns `SHIP`, and the gate passes.
- **If the SR finds issues:** fix, then an SR re-review with the SR report pasted under the marker.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
Because this is an **uncommitted wave**, review the **index**, not `WAVE_BASE_SHA..HEAD`—that commit range is empty. Do not commit the wave before its review gate passes.

The commands and payloads below are proposed, not executed. `<…>` denotes required scenario information that was not supplied.

## 1. Initial integrated-wave code review

Prepare the review source and preserve the pre-fix index tree:

```bash
cd /workspace/project

WAVE_BASE_SHA=1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
REVIEW_DIR=$(mktemp -d)

git status --short
git diff --cached --stat "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" -- \
  src/parse.ts tests/parse.test.ts
git diff --cached --binary "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" -- \
  src/parse.ts tests/parse.test.ts \
  > "$REVIEW_DIR/wave-initial.patch"

# Preserve the accepted, staged wave before any repair.
PRE_FIX_TREE=$(git write-tree)
printf '%s\n' "$PRE_FIX_TREE" > "$REVIEW_DIR/pre-fix-tree"
```

Dispatch one code-quality reviewer for the integrated wave:

```js
subagent({
  agent: "code-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Review the integrated, uncommitted code-touching wave for production readiness.
Spec reviews have accepted its tasks and its scoped test gate has passed.

Requirements:
<full wave task texts and plan reference>

BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
HEAD_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111

IMPORTANT: HEAD has not moved. The deliverable is the staged index, not
BASE_SHA..HEAD. Review the staged patch and read the touched files in full.

Git commands:
git -C /workspace/project diff --cached --stat 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111
git -C /workspace/project diff --cached --binary 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111

Expected staged files:
src/parse.ts
tests/parse.test.ts

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test tests/parse.test.ts

Read-only review: do not edit or commit.
Use the code-reviewer report format, including Verdict, Parallel-safe,
and Behaviour-change.
`
})
```

## 2. Repair after the assumed `FIX_FIRST`

Save the reviewer’s **complete actual report verbatim** as, for example, `$REVIEW_DIR/cr-review-1.md`. Do not replace it with a summary.

With one Moderate finding, dispatch one implementer—not a fan-out:

```js
subagent({
  agent: "implementer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Repair the integrated wave in place.

Original task contract:
<full relevant task text, Tests block, Spec anchors, and test paths>

The initial code-quality report follows verbatim:
<complete actual CR review-1 report>

Address the finding in src/parse.ts and add tests/error.test.ts.
Follow TDD and self-review. Do not modify the approved specification.

SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS:
node --test tests/parse.test.ts

Run only that command for verification. Do not add a separate verification
command for tests/error.test.ts.

This is an uncommitted wave: DO NOT COMMIT.
Preserve the existing staged deliverables. After making the repair, stage:
git -C /workspace/project add -- src/parse.ts tests/error.test.ts

Return DONE, DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, NEEDS_CONTEXT, or BLOCKED explicitly.
Report changes, scoped verification results, and any concerns.
For this wave, DONE means the repair is staged and self-reviewed;
the orchestrator owns the eventual wave commit.
`
})
```

After an acceptable implementer result, inspect staging, capture **only the repair delta**, and run the integrated scoped gate:

```bash
cd /workspace/project

git add -- src/parse.ts tests/error.test.ts
git status --short

PRE_FIX_TREE=$(cat "$REVIEW_DIR/pre-fix-tree")
POST_FIX_TREE=$(git write-tree)

# Only changes since the initial review's staged snapshot.
# Includes the newly added tests/error.test.ts.
git diff --binary "$PRE_FIX_TREE" "$POST_FIX_TREE" \
  > "$REVIEW_DIR/fix.patch"

# Complete integrated wave for eventual CR re-review.
git diff --cached --binary "$WAVE_BASE_SHA" \
  > "$REVIEW_DIR/wave-repaired.patch"

node --test tests/parse.test.ts
```

Do **not** use `git diff HEAD HEAD` or a commit range for the fix delta. HEAD remains the wave base. Do **not** commit now.

## 3. Behaviour-changing repair: dispatch SR first

Because the triggering report says `Behaviour-change: yes`, the repair must pass spec review before CR re-review.

```js
subagent({
  agent: "spec-reviewer",
  async: false,
  cwd: "/workspace/project",
  task: `
Review this behaviour-changing repair against the affected task's specification.

Task contract:
<full affected task text>

Absolute specification path:
<actual absolute spec path>

Spec anchors:
<affected task's exact Spec anchors>

Tests contract — not commands to execute:
<affected task's Tests block verbatim, including via entries if present>

Test paths:
<original task's Test paths>
tests/error.test.ts

Patch to review:
<verbatim contents of REVIEW_DIR/fix.patch>

Read the anchored ranges from the specification itself and read touched files
in full. Do not execute tests or edit files. If the specification or an anchor
cannot be read, report a blocking finding.

This is the first SR review of this behaviour-changing repair, not an SR
re-review triggered by a prior SR report. Do not include a
"Previous review report (re-review trigger)" section.
`
})
```

**Stop here: no accepted SR verdict has arrived.**

The subsequent CR re-review is **not dispatched yet**. If SR accepts, its sources will be:

- **Whole review source:** `$REVIEW_DIR/wave-repaired.patch`, the complete staged wave against `WAVE_BASE_SHA`.
- **`## Fix delta`:** `$REVIEW_DIR/fix.patch` pasted verbatim—not a SHA range.
- **`## Previous review report (re-review trigger)`:** the complete initial CR report pasted verbatim.
- The required CR trajectory instructions.
- `SCOPED_TEST_COMMANDS: node --test tests/parse.test.ts`.

The wave commit remains deferred until the required reviews accept and the wave gate passes; its task indices remain `in_progress`.
